events.description: Rumsfeld asks Jim Haynes to get the law changed so contractors can provide force protection.
General Counsel info memo to SecDef on what is needed to change 10 U.S.C. § 2465; notes the supplemental request includes proposed legislation.
Rumsfeld tells Powell Moore to work up a plan for a full court press on contracting out force protection.
Rumsfeld memo to Jim Haynes asking to change the law that only the military can provide force protection.
General Counsel info memo to SecDef on 10 U.S.C. § 2465 and proposed legislation in the supplemental request.
Rumsfeld memo to Powell Moore requesting a plan to contract out force protection in the U.S. and probably elsewhere.

key_claims: Rumsfeld wanted the law barring contractors from providing force protection changed, calling it "crazy".
10 U.S.C. § 2465 generally prohibits contracting out security guard services.
The President's supplemental appropriations request includes proposed legislation to allow contracting out security guard functions.
This chunk contains no information on jihadist networks in Afghanistan or Pakistan.
